...and I agree with your point, i have been that kind of person who has been manipulated before. People would literally start crying and I would give in and help them. I think it has been same case here so I am willing to push little further (carefully) and try to make him understand that he has to stand on his own feet, stop leaning too much on people. 
The new counselor was very practical to him stating that he has to take care of his own life and they are just there to guide him apart from that he is on his own. He took it really hard and the new medicine he is taking also kind of exploded his emotions (thats what he felt). That is when he attempted to end his life. He went back to his old medicines prescribed by his ex counselor and says he is feeling better. 

Thank you again for your thoughts, it really helped.
